plan.title: SRC-TNC-038 RFQ Required Clause Blocks Vendor Submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one line item for the vendor quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the technical stage first to verify RFQ-only terms are not shown there.
Confirm the RFQ-specific required clause is absent from the technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage for the terms and quote submission.
Confirm the required RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Verify submission is blocked while the required clause remains unaccepted.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the quote after all required terms are accepted.
Confirm the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
